cleared.check: Swap events with amount0 = amount1 = 0 and price, tick and liquidity unchanged, which the step formulas cannot produce
cleared.result: 451 such events across the windows. PoolManager.swap rejects amountSpecified == 0 (src/PoolManager.sol:193), and a nonzero amount always moves the price or spends the amount (src/libraries/Pool.sol:344-437, src/libraries/SwapMath.sol:63-105). The only path to a zero swap is a hook with BEFORE_SWAP_RETURNS_DELTA_FLAG whose specified delta cancels the amount (src/libraries/Hooks.sol:266-277), after which Pool.swap returns ZERO_DELTA without touching state (src/libraries/Pool.sol:320). Every such event whose pool key was found has a hook address with bit 3 set; the rest are on pools whose key no public source gave, and they fit only that path. The event is correct and moves no funds.
cleared.source: src/libraries/Hooks.sol:266-277

cleared.check: Event semantics for pools with hooks that return deltas: the Swap event carries the pool delta of Pool.swap, computed from amountToSwap after the beforeSwap delta, before afterSwap adjusts the caller delta
cleared.result: src/PoolManager.sol:202-250 emits delta.amount0(), delta.amount1() of pool.swap(params) with amountSpecified = amountToSwap, so a hook delta changes the specified amount the loop starts from and never the arithmetic the event reports. The replay therefore needs no special case for return-delta hooks: it derives the specified amount from the event, and all swaps on return-delta hook pools in the windows match. Hook and token behaviour was not swept (owner instruction).
cleared.source: src/PoolManager.sol:230-250

leadResults.answer: Closed. Fresh windows on all 21 networks give 70053 mined swaps: 63848 match one step of computeSwapStep and the other 6205 match the full Pool.swap loop to the unit in amount0, amount1, sqrtPriceX96, liquidity and tick, with the event fee checked against slot0 on 5384 swaps of static-fee pools and the feeGrowthGlobal change in storage checked on 780 swaps. None is set aside and none is unmatched. The 869 distinct samples stored by cycles 8 to 12 all replay as well, including those earlier endpoints could not serve. The residue of about 3,300 pairs in OPCODES.md is swaps that take several steps or cross initialized ticks. Rerun with the real pool key they all match, including pools whose tick spacing the old candidate list lacked (90 on Ink, 190 on Arc). The new windows add two kinds the single-step test cannot take: pools initialized inside the window and zero-amount swaps of return-delta hooks; both match as well. No line of SwapMath, SqrtPriceMath, FullMath, TickMath, TickBitmap, LiquidityMath, UnsafeMath or Pool computes anything other than the source says on any network's mined blocks. replay2.py sits in the unit's work directory because this cycle may not write to tools/opdiff.
